configure.title: Ingoa Tauine

configure.title: Ngā Pae Whakapae
configure.description: Ka kōaro i ngā tuaka o te kauwhata pae kia tuhia he kauwhata pae whakapae. Kia mōhio me kōaro hoki ō tautuhinga tuaka nā te mea ka whakaatu te Tuaka Y i ngā tapanga, ā, ko te Tuaka X ngā uara.

configure.title: Tāpae Pae
configure.description: Ki te tautuhia ki te pono, ka tāpaetia ngā pae raupapa e tēnei āhuatanga.

configure.title: Tohatoha Raupapa
configure.description: Ki te tautuhia ki te pono, ka tohu ia pae i tētahi raupapa, ā, ko te huānga raraunga he huānga ahu-kotahi o ngā uara raraunga, kaua he huānga raupapa o ngā raupapa.

advanced.title: Kōaro Raraunga
advanced.description: Kōaro i ngā raraunga tae atu ki ngā tapanga, te raupapa raupapa me ngā huānga raraunga raupapa katoa.

advanced.title: Ripanga HTML

advanced.title: Iti Rawa o te Kauwhata

advanced.description: Tohua te tawhiti i ngā pika o ngā pae i tētahi rōpū.

advanced.title: Aratau Tāpae
advanced.description: Ki te tautuhia ki "true", ka hangaia e tēnei āhuatanga he tapeke mō ia pūwāhi raupapa. Ka pā hoki tēnei ki te tuaka-y me ngā rohe whānui o te kauwhata. Ki te tautuhia ki "false", ka akiaki tēnei āhuatanga i ngā pae tāpae kia tuhia mai i te rārangi kore. I te aratau tāpae, kāore he pānga o te āhuatanga "seriesBarDistance".
